lemmas.primary_translation: to get someone to do anything at all / to boss someone around

definitions.text: få noen til å gjøre hva det skal være
definitions.translation: get someone to do anything at all (lit. twist, spin, or wind someone around one’s little finger)

examples.en: the salesman had us wrapped around his little finger
the musician has the audience wrapped around his little finger

examples.no: han kan sno deg rundt lillefingeren
examples.en: he can wrap you around his little finger
